data.name: KOROD
data.detailed_description:
A Dark Prophecy Beyond Death

 Once upon a time, on a blood-drenched battlefield, the warrior Kor takes a devastating blow to the chest, breathes his last... and opens his eyes in Tamag, the underworld of eternal darkness. Yet, something is horribly wrong; death refuses to claim him. Every time he is torn apart, he is thrown back to the beginning of the dungeon, more ferocious than before. Is this eternal cycle of resurrection a blessing, or the work of an unseen hand pulling the strings of a dark prophecy? Start a bloody rebellion to uncover the hidden truth of Erlik Han, the lord of the underworld!

Combat Forged in Brutality

 In this ruthless Action-RPG universe adorned with the ancient whispers of Turkic mythology, your destiny is shaped by how you swing your blade. In KOROD, your character adapts to your brutality: charge fearlessly into the fray, and your Strength (STR) multiplies; dance around strikes like a shadow, and your Agility (AGI) becomes legendary.

Blessings of the Ancient Gods

 Noticing your inexplicable immortality, other ancient gods and spirits (Umay, Kızagan, Asena) begin to bestow their blessings upon you, driven by their own mysterious motives. As you delve deeper into the dungeons, listen to their whispers.

Pierce the veil of mystery, wield divine powers, and forge your own destiny!

data.short_description: Breathing his last on a bloody battlefield, Kor awakens in the underworld of Tamag. In this ruthless Action-RPG born from Turkic mythology, wield abilities that evolve with your playstyle and carve through endless dungeons! Death is only the beginning.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • Additional Notes: System requirements may change during the development phase.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10300H
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • Additional Notes: Using SSDs significantly reduces loading times.

content_descriptors.notes: The game features fast-paced sword fighting and fantastical violence, but it absolutely does not contain red blood, dismemberment (gore), or realistic gore.
